# Prepartaions and checks

## Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gridExtra)
```

## Load the data

```{r}
counts_df79<-read_tsv('../../data/clean/GSE119579_counts_clean.tsv')
counts_df52<-read_tsv('../../data/clean/GSE158752_counts_clean.tsv')
meta_df79<-read_csv('../../data/clean/GSE119579_metadata_clean.csv')
meta_df52<-read_csv('../../data/clean/GSE158752_metadata_clean.csv')
```

## Checks

```{r}
sum(is.na(counts_df52))
sum(is.na(counts_df79))
colSums(is.na(meta_df52))
colSums(is.na(meta_df79))
identical(colnames(counts_df52)[-1],meta_df52$sample)
identical(colnames(counts_df79)[-1],meta_df79$sample)
identical(counts_df52$gene_id,counts_df79$gene_id)
table(meta_df52$group)
table(meta_df52$condition)
table(meta_df79$group)
table(meta_df79$condition)
summary(as.numeric(as.matrix(counts_df52[,-1])))
summary(as.numeric(as.matrix(counts_df79[,-1])))
dim(counts_df52)
dim(counts_df79)
dim(meta_df52)
dim(meta_df79)
anyDuplicated(counts_df52$gene_id)
anyDuplicated(counts_df79$gene_id)
sapply(counts_df52[-1], class)
sapply(counts_df79[-1], class)
```

# Distributions and log2 transform

## Select random sample
```{r}
sample_id <- colnames(counts_df52)[10]

df_counts52 <- data.frame(
  expression = counts_df52[[sample_id]]
)
```

## Raw distribution
```{r}
p1 <- df_counts52 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = expression)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 50,
    fill = "lightgreen",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Raw counts",
    subtitle = sample_id,
    x = "Raw count",
    y = "Number of genes"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)
  
p1
```

## log2 distribution
```{r}
p2<-df_counts52 |>
  ggplot(aes(x=log2(expression+1)))+
  geom_histogram(
    bins=50,
    fill='cyan',
    color='black',
    linewidth = 0.3
  )+
  labs(title='Log2-transformed raw counts',
       subtitle = sample_id,
       x="log2(raw count)",
    y = "Number of genes"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

p2
```

```{r}
com_distr<-grid.arrange(p1,p2,ncol=2)
```

Raw RNA-seq counts showed a strongly right-skewed distribution, with most genes exhibiting low expression and a small number of highly expressed genes. Log2 transformation improved visualization of the expression distribution, revealing a substantial proportion of low-count genes.

#DESeq

```{r}
library(DESeq2)
```

## Prepare for Deseq for geneset 52

```{r}
meta_df52 <- meta_df52 |>
  mutate(
    age = as.numeric(age),
    sex = factor(sex),
    batch = factor(batch),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("control", "asthma"))
  )
```

### Check
```{r}
table(meta_df52$group, meta_df52$sex)

table(meta_df52$group, meta_df52$batch)

summary(meta_df52$age[meta_df52$group == "control"])

summary(meta_df52$age[meta_df52$group == "asthma"])
```
```{r}
counts_mat52 <- counts_df52 |>
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") |>
  as.matrix()
```


### DESeq only for condition
```{r}
dds52_only_c<-DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_mat52,
  colData = meta_df52,
  design = ~group
)
```

#### Filtering

```{r}
keep_dds52_only_c<-rowSums(counts(dds52_only_c))>=10
dds52_deseq_r_only_c<-dds52_only_c[keep_dds52_only_c,]
```

#### PCA plot only with condition

```{r}
pca1_52_only_c<-plotPCA(rlog(dds52_deseq_r_only_c), intgroup=c("condition"))+
  ggtitle("PCA – Asthma vs Healthy Controls")
```

#### Run DESeq only for condition

```{r}
dds52_deseq_only_c<-DESeq(dds52_deseq_r_only_c)
```

### DESeq with confounders

```{r}
dds52_with_c<-DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_mat52,
  colData = meta_df52,
  design = ~age+sex+batch+group
)
```

#### Filtering

```{r}
keep_dds52_with_c<-rowSums(counts(dds52_with_c))>=10
dds52_deseq_r_with_c<-dds52_with_c[keep_dds52_with_c,]
```

#### PCA plot with confounders
```{r}
data_for_pca_with_c_52 <- rlog(dds52_deseq_r_with_c)

pca_52_sex<-plotPCA(data_for_pca_with_c_52, intgroup = c("group", "sex"))+
  labs(
  title = "PCA - Asthma vs Healthy Controls by gender",
  color = NULL
)+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

pca_52_batch<-plotPCA(data_for_pca_with_c_52, intgroup = "batch")+
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Batch")+
  labs(
  title = "PCA - Asthma vs Healthy Controls by batch"
)+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

```

```{r}
pca_age52 <- plotPCA(
  data_for_pca_with_c_52,
  intgroup = c('group',"age"),
  returnData = TRUE
)
pca_age52$diagnosis<-colData(data_for_pca_with_c_52)$group

percentVar_52 <- round(100 * attr(pca_age52, "percentVar"))

pca_52_age<-ggplot(pca_age52, aes(PC1, PC2, color = age, shape = diagnosis)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +
  labs(
    title = "PCA plot colored by age",
    x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar_52[1], "% variance"),
    y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar_52[2], "% variance"),
    color = "Age",
    shape = "Group")+
  theme_classic()
```

#### Run DESeq with confounders

```{r}
dds52_deseq_with_c<-DESeq(dds52_deseq_r_with_c)
```

## Results

#### Extract results from DESeq
```{r}
# GSE158752
res52_only_c <- results(
  dds52_deseq_only_c,
  contrast = c("group", "asthma", "control"),
  alpha = 0.05
)

res52_with_c <- results(
  dds52_deseq_with_c,
  contrast = c("group", "asthma", "control"),
  alpha = 0.05
)

# GSE119579
res79_only_c <- results(
  dds79_deseq_only_c,
  contrast = c("group", "asthma", "control"),
  alpha = 0.05
)

res79_with_c <- results(
  dds79_deseq_with_c,
  contrast = c("group", "asthma", "control"),
  alpha = 0.05
)
```

#### Filter for padj<0.05
```{r}
n_sig52_only <- sum(res52_only_c$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
n_sig52_with <- sum(res52_with_c$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

n_sig79_only <- sum(res79_only_c$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
n_sig79_with <- sum(res79_with_c$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
```

#### Number of significant differentially expressed genes in each test
```{r}
c(
  GSE158752_unadjusted = n_sig52_only,
  GSE158752_adjusted = n_sig52_with,
  GSE119579_unadjusted = n_sig79_only,
  GSE119579_adjusted = n_sig79_with
)
```

#### Number of common genes between the two tests for the dataset ending in 52
```{r}
sig52_only <- rownames(res52_only_c)[
  !is.na(res52_only_c$padj) & res52_only_c$padj < 0.05
]

sig52_with <- rownames(res52_with_c)[
  !is.na(res52_with_c$padj) & res52_with_c$padj < 0.05
]

n_common52 <- length(intersect(sig52_only, sig52_with))
n_common52
```

#### Number of common genes between the two tests for the dataset ending in 79

```{r}
sig79_only <- rownames(res79_only_c)[
  !is.na(res79_only_c$padj) & res79_only_c$padj < 0.05
]

sig79_with <- rownames(res79_with_c)[
  !is.na(res79_with_c$padj) & res79_with_c$padj < 0.05
]

n_common79 <- length(intersect(sig79_only, sig79_with))
sig79_only
sig79_with
n_common79
```


#### Test how many samples and genes were tested and how many had pval,padk <0.05 in dataset ending in 52
```{r}
c(
  samples = ncol(dds52_deseq_with_c),
  genes_tested = sum(!is.na(res52_with_c$padj)),
  pvalue_below_005 = sum(res52_with_c$pvalue < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
  padj_below_005 = sum(res52_with_c$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
)
```

#### Test how many samples and genes were tested and how many had pval,padk <0.05 in dataset ending in 79

```{r}
c(
  samples = ncol(dds79_deseq_with_c),
  genes_tested = sum(!is.na(res79_with_c$padj)),
  pvalue_below_005 = sum(res79_with_c$pvalue < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
  padj_below_005 = sum(res79_with_c$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
)
```

## Volacano plots
### For the adjusted set ending in 52
```{r}
res_df_52 <- as_tibble(res52_with_c, rownames = "gene") |>
  drop_na(padj, log2FoldChange) |>
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Up in Asthma",
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Up in Controls",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

top_labels_52 <- res_df_52 |>
  filter(group != "Not significant") |>
  slice_min(padj, n = 10)

volcano_spec_52<-ggplot(res_df_52, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Up in Asthma" = "firebrick",
      "Up in Controls" = "steelblue",
      "Not significant" = "grey80"
    )
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = top_labels_52,
    aes(label = gene),
    size = 3,
    vjust = -0.6,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = max(res_df_52$log2FoldChange), y = 0.3,
           label = "Higher in Asthma \u2192", hjust = 1, size = 3,
           fontface = "italic", color = "firebrick") +
  annotate("text", x = min(res_df_52$log2FoldChange), y = 0.3,
           label = "\u2190 Higher in Controls", hjust = 0, size = 3,
           fontface = "italic", color = "steelblue") +
  labs(x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
       title = "GSE158752 - Asthma vs Controls (Adjusted)") +
  theme_minimal()
volcano_spec_52
```

### For the adjusted set ending in 52

```{r}
res_df_79 <- as_tibble(res79_with_c, rownames = "gene") |>
  drop_na(padj, log2FoldChange) |>
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Up in Asthma",
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Up in Controls",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

top_labels_79 <- res_df_79 |>
  filter(group != "Not significant") |>
  slice_min(padj, n = 10)

volcano_spec_79<-ggplot(res_df_79, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Up in Asthma" = "firebrick",
      "Up in Controls" = "steelblue",
      "Not significant" = "grey80"
    )
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
  data = top_labels_79,
  aes(label = gene),
  size = 3,
  max.overlaps = Inf
) +
  annotate("text", x = max(res_df_79$log2FoldChange), y = 0.3,
           label = "Higher in Asthma \u2192", hjust = 1, size = 3,
           fontface = "italic", color = "firebrick") +
  annotate("text", x = min(res_df_79$log2FoldChange), y = 0.3,
           label = "\u2190 Higher in Controls", hjust = 0, size = 3,
           fontface = "italic", color = "steelblue") +
  labs(x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
       title = "GSE119579 - Asthma vs Controls (Adjusted)") +
  theme_minimal()
volcano_spec_79
```

# Match gene IDs with symbols

### Load annotation table

```{r}
gene_mapping <- readr::read_tsv(
  "../../data/Entrez_to_Ensembl_Symbol_small.tsv",
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character())
)
```

### Check for duplicates
```{r}
gene_mapping |>
  dplyr::count(GeneID) |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)
```

### Map geneset ending in 79

#### Check mapping
```{r}
gene_mapping |>
  filter(GeneID %in% sig79_with)
```

#### Add ensemble id 
```{r}
deseq_res79_tbl <- as_tibble(res79_with_c, rownames = "GeneID") |>
  left_join(gene_mapping, by = "GeneID")
```

#### Checks
```{r}
nrow(deseq_res79_tbl) == nrow(res79_with_c)
#how many genes got and ensemble id
sum(!is.na(deseq_res79_tbl$EnsemblGeneID)) 
```

### Map geneset ending in 52

#### Check mapping
```{r}
gene_mapping |>
  filter(GeneID %in% sig52_with)
```

#### Add ensemble id 
```{r}
deseq_res52_tbl <- as_tibble(res52_with_c, rownames = "GeneID") |>
  left_join(gene_mapping, by = "GeneID")
```

#### Checks
```{r}
nrow(deseq_res52_tbl) == nrow(res52_with_c)
#how many genes got and ensemble id
sum(!is.na(deseq_res52_tbl$EnsemblGeneID)) 
```

### Check how many genes from the significant ones got an ensemble id

```{r}
deseq_res79_tbl |>
  filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05) |>
  summarise(
    significant = n(),
    mapped = sum(!is.na(EnsemblGeneID))
  )
```

```{r}
deseq_res52_tbl |>
  filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05) |>
  summarise(
    significant = n(),
    mapped = sum(!is.na(EnsemblGeneID))
  )
```

# Create seeds lists

```{r}
seeds79 <- deseq_res79_tbl |>
  filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05) |>
  dplyr::select(GeneID, Symbol, EnsemblGeneID, log2FoldChange, padj)
```

```{r}
seeds52 <- deseq_res52_tbl |>
  filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05) |>
  dplyr::select(GeneID, Symbol, EnsemblGeneID, log2FoldChange, padj)
```
